etsy.title: Christmas Add Your Own Face PNG, 40 Elf Santa Reindeer Photo Characters, Kids Christmas Craft, Classroom Bulletin Board, Printable PDF
etsy.description:
Turn your little one into an elf, Santa, a reindeer or a gingerbread friend! 🎄 40 faceless Christmas characters with a see-through face hole: just add a photo of your child's face.

✨ WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 40 PNG characters, transparent background + transparent face hole (high resolution)
• 47-page printable PDF: every character on its own page with a white circle to glue a face photo on (US Letter + A4)
• Overview pages of all characters
• "OUR LITTLE ELVES" bulletin board letters
• Simple how-to: on paper (print, cut, glue) or digital (Canva free, Google Slides, PowerPoint: put the photo behind the character)

🎅 CHARACTERS
Elves (gift, baker, skater, sled, wrapping, puppy, nice list, pajamas, drummer, bell, painter, snowball and more), Santa, Mrs. Claus, reindeer, gingerbread, snowman, penguin, polar bear, nutcracker, angel, Christmas tree, gift box, star, candy cane, hot cocoa, ornament, snowflake fairy, skier, carol singer, fox, teddy bear, gnome, mouse, owl, train conductor.

👩‍🏫 PERFECT FOR
Classroom bulletin boards, preschool and kindergarten crafts, Christmas cards, family photo fun, party photo booth printouts, keepsakes for grandparents.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. You get 2 PDFs (US Letter + A4) and 1 ZIP folder with the 40 PNG files.

PLEASE NOTE
Personal use and use in one classroom. Please do not resell or share the files. Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
